items.t: Wave motion, sound and the Doppler effect

items.q: A body of mass 45 kg moving at 116 m/s collides with a stationary body of mass 36 kg and they move together. Find their common velocity, correct to three decimal places.
items.s: By conservation of momentum, v = (45 x 116)/(45 + 36) = 64.444 m/s.
items.t: Momentum, impulse and collisions
